title: lucy Airspace
description: An org: one hard-isolated sandbox with its own credentials, postures and runways. Its name and namespace are the org's name. Stub: later slices add fields.

supervisor.description: Opts the org into supervision of its Pilots' questions (LUCY-RUN-010), which only proposes answers; only the owner answers. Built-in safety rules and the org's rules apply with this alone; the models (route, smallModel, largeModel, dailyTokens, all or none) are asked only when the daemon is also started with --supervise.

route.description: The org's credential gateway route that model calls go through; the gateway holds the key.

largeModel.description: The model asked when the small one is not confident.

dailyTokens.description: The most tokens the supervisor may spend for the org in a UTC day; once spent, questions go straight to the owner.

rules.description: Ordered rules asked before any model: the first whose match finds the question either proposes its fixed answer (as supervisor/rules) or sends the question to the owner with no model call. They can only add to the built-in safety rules, which always send questions about secrets, credentials, payments and irreversible or production changes to the owner.

match.description: An RE2 regular expression, matched case-insensitively anywhere in the question.

propose.description: The answer to propose, at most 1024 bytes (UTF-8); the owner still answers.

owner.description: Send the question to the owner, with no model call.
